emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over NC, SC: Charlotte city, Raleigh city, Greensboro city, Durham city, and Winston-Salem city and 40 other communities sit under NIFC's Significant Fire Potential outlook (days 2,3). USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 1% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
